rationale: Round 9, resubmission of corr e996bf0a (the bugs_open/011 reported_conditions residual). Round 8 was 11 approve / 1 objection: bug_historian (medium) — parseReportedConditions capped the list at maxReportedConditionsPerResponse via a bare break, so over-cap WELL-FORMED entries were dropped silently: not counted in skipped, indistinguishable from a clean parse of a short list — the exact silence rounds 5/7 cured, re-entering at the cap boundary of the very function built to guard against it. The 'missing' item named the absent test: length > cap, all well-formed, truncation counted/warned DISTINCTLY from skipped. BOTH ARE NOW FIXED IN CODE AND COMMITTED (2f4fc0596, 2026-07-24). (1) parseReportedConditions returns a fourth value, truncated — the count of entries never examined because the cap fired (indexed loop: truncated = len(list) - i at the break). The accounting now lives at the PURE, unit-tested seam. (2) persistReportedConditions warns on truncated > 0 with its own message and fields (truncated/persisted/cap), DISTINCT from the skipped warn, and the previous caller-side re-derivation from the raw list (which round 8's sketch elided — my fault, the sketch was not final-state) is DELETED in favour of the counted value. truncated is deliberately NOT folded into skipped: a capacity drop and a junk drop have different remedies (raise the cap / report less, versus fix the emitter), so folding would misdiagnose a healthy-but-chatty reporter as a broken one. The council's load-bearing distinction is EXTENDED, not collapsed: absent != malformed != partly-dropped != over-cap. (3) The named-missing test now exists verbatim: TestParseReportedConditionsOverCapTruncationIsCountedDistinctly (15 well-formed -> 10 parsed, skipped=0, truncated=5, malformed=false), and the capped and mixed-list tests pin both counts in both directions (flood: truncated=2*cap, skipped=0; mixed: skipped=2, truncated=0). All 8 package tests green against git archive HEAD + these two files. Standing constraints preserved untouched: the sender allowlist (guardian round-5 veto resolution) is not modified; no wire change (the response body shape is unchanged — this is chassis-internal accounting); no schema change; single caller, same file. Disclosure carried forward from round 8: the round-6/7 mechanism is live in production since v1.0.1140 via an owner sweep commit (bca5d8255) — this round-9 delta is committed (2f4fc0596) and INERT until the next chassis image roll. No Council-Reviewed trailer has been or will be claimed unless this round returns APPROVED.
